# Prompt
Rank the eight targets from lowest to highest cynomolgus-to-human albumin KD ratio at pH6. Human results are supplied and cynomolgus results are withheld.

All molecules are the VHH-Fc constructs listed in Table9; sequence1 contains the complete tested fusion chain. Molecular names have been anonymized. The row reference is a measured reference and is not a target. All eight other rows must be predicted. SPR uses anti-human-Fc capture of the VHH-Fc on CM5, albumin as analyte at0,31.25,62.5,125,250,500nM, Biacore8K,25C,120s analyte injections at30uL/min and1:1 fitting; HBS-EP+ running buffer. The source neutral pH7.4 label is displayed as pH7.5 under the benchmark convention; acid pH6 is unchanged. 

Use only the supplied CSV. Do not browse, execute code or call external tools. Return only one comma-separated line containing all eight target names exactly once, without explanations.
